instruction: Choose a suitable tool from ANSYS, Abaqus, and AutoCAD to complete the task. Use a command-line or scripting workflow. Use the selected tool to perform a simply supported beam analysis under a uniformly distributed load. Use the N-mm-MPa unit system. 1. Part: 3D Deformable Solid, Extrusion - Sketch a 10 mm x 10 mm rectangle in the Y-Z plane - Extrude along the global X-axis to length 200 mm - This creates a beam with cross-section 10 mm x 10 mm and span 200 mm 2. Property: - Material Steel: E = 210000 MPa, nu = 0.3 - Solid Homogeneous section 3. Assembly: Create an instance. 4. Step: Static, General, named Step-Load. 5. Load: - Create RP-1 at the geometric center of the left end face (X=0, Y=5 mm, Z=5 mm) and couple it kinematically to that end face - Create RP-2 at the geometric center of the right end face (X=200 mm, Y=5 mm, Z=5 mm) and couple it kinematically to that end face - RP-1: U1 = U2 = U3 = 0, UR2 = UR3 = 0 (pinned support, allow UR1 rotation about beam axis) - RP-2: U2 = U3 = 0, UR2 = UR3 = 0 (roller support, allow U1 axial motion and UR1 rotation) - Apply Pressure = 0.05 MPa downward on the beam top surface (Y=10 mm face, equivalent to q = 0.5 N/mm) 6. Mesh: - Global seed size: 5 mm - Element type: appropriate three-dimensional solid element formulation 7. Job: Create Job-UDL and submit for solving. 8. Deliverables: save the native model artifact and native solver result artifact on the Desktop, and write `C:/Users/user/Desktop/metrics.json` with numeric fields for the requested metrics. Software launch locations: Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`; ANSYS: multiple ANSYS launch shortcuts are available under `C:\Users\Public\Desktop`; choose the most suitable ANSYS shortcut for the task; AutoCAD 2024: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\AutoCAD 2024.lnk`.
